criteria.requirement: The call is for qualified young Africans across the continent and the Diaspora; the programme recruits young African professionals from AU Member States. The pages read publish no country list.
criteria.applicant: Nationality: Democratic Republic of the Congo.
criteria.missing: A sentence or list naming the DRC (or all AU Member States) as eligible: the pages read give no country list and do not name the DRC.
criteria.quote: Applications are opened for qualified young Africans across the continent and the Diaspora from 26 March to 26 April 2026

criteria.requirement: 18 to 35 years, and under 35 upon completion of service (13th cohort call).
criteria.applicant: Recorded only as under 30, which stays under 35 at the end of a 12-month service.
criteria.quote: 18 – 35 years (must be under 35 upon completion of service)

criteria.requirement: A post-secondary certified qualification (TVET, Bachelor's or Master's).
criteria.applicant: Bachelor's degree (Licence) in Business Administration, obtained in 2024.
criteria.quote: Post-secondary certified qualification (TVET, Bachelor’s, or Master’s)

criteria.requirement: Relevant professional work and verifiable volunteering experience; no minimum duration is stated.
criteria.applicant: Under one year of internships and field assignments (logistics, public-sector research, vaccination-campaign monitoring); no volunteering is recorded as such.
criteria.missing: Whether the internships and the vaccination-campaign monitoring assignment count as relevant professional work and verifiable volunteering, and the minimum the next call will ask for.
criteria.quote: Relevant professional work and verifiable volunteering experience

criteria.requirement: Availability for 12 months of professional volunteer service in 2026/27 and willingness to live in another AU Member State.
criteria.applicant: Availability and willingness to relocate are not recorded in the profile.
criteria.missing: The applicant's availability for 12 months and willingness to live in another AU Member State.
criteria.quote: Available in 2026/27 to dedicate 12 months for professional volunteer service and willing to live in another AU Member State

funding.conditions: A monthly stipend to cover living expenses, plus a separation allowance on successful completion; the amounts are not stated.
funding.quote: A monthly stipend to cover living expenses and a separation allowance upon successful completion.

funding.conditions: An economy return ticket to the place of deployment.
funding.quote: An AU Service Passport and an economy return ticket to the place of deployment.

funding.conditions: Accommodation is not mentioned in the benefits listed on the press release.
Insurance is not mentioned in the benefits listed on the press release.

out_of_pocket: Unknown: the stipend amount, accommodation and insurance are not stated on the pages read.
